apps.name: Your Money Space
apps.shortDescription: Track spending, investments, budgets and shared expenses in one app.
apps.description:
Your Money Space – Manage Your Money in One Place

Your Money Space is a personal finance app designed to help you organize your money, track spending, manage accounts, monitor investments and share expenses with friends.

Whether you're managing everyday expenses, tracking your investments or settling shared bills, Your Money Space brings your financial activity together in one convenient place.

Key Features

Personal Finance Dashboard
Get an overview of your financial activity, income, expenses and recent transactions.

Expense & Income Tracking
Record income and expenses, categorize transactions, add notes and payment details, and review your spending history.

Manage Multiple Accounts
Organize your finances across different accounts and keep your financial records structured.

Budgets & Financial Insights
Set category-based budgets and review your financial activity to better understand your spending habits.

Shared Expenses
Split expenses with friends using equal or custom allocations. Track outstanding balances, repayment requests and settlements.

Investment Portfolio Tracking
Organize your investments, including Fixed Deposits (FDs), Recurring Deposits (RDs), Mutual Funds, stocks and other assets.

Portfolio Analytics
Track invested amounts, portfolio values, returns and investment activity with portfolio insights and performance calculations.

Investment Ledger
Keep investment activity separate from everyday expenses and track contributions, withdrawals and transfers.

Financial Profiles
Organize finances into separate profiles to manage different financial spaces.

Statements
Review your transaction history and generate or share statements where supported.

Take Control of Your Financial Life

Your Money Space brings everyday money management, shared expenses and investment tracking together to help you stay organized and make more informed financial decisions.

Download Your Money Space and start organizing your finances today.
